verdict.rationale: The docs describe sharing data with other clusters without exposing cluster credentials or sharing compute, using read-only access with real-time revocable permissions. Combined with compute–storage separation on shared object storage, this points to live, zero-copy sharing. However, the evidence only says "other clusters" and never confirms sharing across separate accounts or organizations. missing for 10: explicit cross-account/cross-organization sharing, explicit confirmation that shared data is live and not copied, setup documentation detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
